game.title: Comet Dodge
game.objective: Dodge falling comets and asteroid walls while collecting stars to maximize score and distance across two ships.
game.controls: Hold or drag left and right on the screen to steer the rocket horizontally.
game.core_loop: Steer the rocket left and right to dodge incoming comets and catch falling stars, earning points, combo multipliers, and near-miss bonuses.
game.progression: As distance increases in kilometers, the game introduces harder obstacle patterns in sequence: Comet Walls, Zig-Zag swerving comets, Split Rocks, and Double Walls.
game.hook_idea: Threading the Comet Wall gap with a 'CLOSE! +5' near-miss bonus at t=12.4-14.0s, or weaving into the Double Wall explosion at t=44.4-46.8s.
